Understanding Market Sectors

Each sector tracks a basket of representative items to create a market index. Price changes reflect the average movement across all items in the sector, giving you a quick read on which parts of the economy are moving.

Use sector trends to identify merching opportunities. When a sector is rising, individual items within it may have increased demand. When falling, there may be buying opportunities.
